**Comparability note:** Both companies use calendar-year fiscal years ending December 31, so FY2023→FY2024 growth rates are directly comparable. One caveat on basis: Meta reports "revenue" while Amazon reports "net sales" — both are the top-line GAAP revenue measure, so the comparison is reasonable, though Amazon's mix includes large third-party/gross-vs-net presentation effects.

**Calculation:**

| Company | FY2023 | FY2024 | Growth |
|---|---|---|---|
| Meta Platforms | $134,902M | $164,501M | +21.94% |
| Amazon.com | $574,785M | $637,959M | +10.99% |

- Meta: revenue rose from $134,902M in FY2023 to $164,501M in FY2024 [DOC: meta_amzn_growth.txt — Meta Platforms 10-K FY2024, accession 0001326801-25-000017], a gain of 21.94%.
- Amazon: net sales rose from $574,785M in FY2023 to $637,959M in FY2024 [DOC: meta_amzn_growth.txt — Amazon.com 10-K FY2024, accession 0001018724-25-000004], a gain of 10.99%.

Meta grew faster, by approximately 10.95 percentage points (21.94% − 10.99%). Note this is a difference in growth *rates* off very different revenue bases — Amazon's smaller percentage gain still represented ~$63.2B of incremental sales versus Meta's ~$29.6B.

ANSWER: Meta grew faster — 21.9% vs. Amazon's 11.0%, a difference of approximately 10.95 percentage points.
